headline: Mathematics and Physics, explained until it makes sense.
intro: I tutor students who want to understand a topic, not just survive the next paper. Lessons are patient and structured, and always begin with finding out what you already know.

subjects.title: Mathematics
subjects.text: Pure, applied and statistics, with careful attention to exam technique and to the reasons behind each method.

subjects.title: Physics
subjects.text: Mechanics, fields, waves and more, built from first principles and checked against worked examples.

subjects.title: GIS and spatial analysis
subjects.text: QGIS, raster analysis, map design and multi-criteria methods such as AHP, for students and early researchers.

approach.title: Find the gap
approach.text: A short diagnostic conversation shows where understanding stops and why.

approach.title: Build the idea
approach.text: New material is introduced through worked examples and questions, not lectures.

approach.title: Practise on purpose
approach.text: Exam-style problems chosen to fix the specific weakness, not to fill time.

approach.title: Review and adjust
approach.text: Every few lessons we check progress against your goal and change the plan.

formats.title: Online lessons
formats.text: Live, one to one, with a shared digital whiteboard.

formats.title: In-person lessons
formats.text: In and around Patan, by arrangement.

formats.title: Exam-preparation blocks
formats.text: Focused revision sprints before mocks and final papers.

closing: Tell me the subject, the level and the exam date, and I'll suggest a plan.
